entry.title: What If You Had a Third Leg?

media:group.media:title: What If You Had a Third Leg?
media:group.media:description:
You wake up on a Monday with a third leg. A real one, right in the middle: a knee, a foot and a sock that doesn't match. 🦵
You outrun the city bus, play goalkeeper like a tripod, pass your driving test with a foot on every pedal, and the barista who wrote «Kevin» on your cup for two years finally notices you. But the leg also gets you banned from the race, stuck at airport security and playing footsie with the wrong foot at dinner with her parents. Thirty days, eight moments, blessing or curse.
So would you keep the third leg, or take the surgery? Tell me in the comments 👇

entry.title: What If You Were Reborn in the Stone Age, but Remembered Everything?

media:group.media:title: What If You Were Reborn in the Stone Age, but Remembered Everything?
media:group.media:description:
▶ NEW VIDEO: What If You Had a Third Leg? https://youtu.be/k7AoENCubtw
You die on the night bus home and wake up barefoot in the snow, forty thousand years ago, in someone else's body. No phone, no lighter, no steel. Just a cave lion at the edge of the trees, and everything you ever read. 🔥
You make fire from flint and pyrite, boil water with hot rocks and make soap to save a little girl. You teach a whole tribe to count, fish under the ice, tame a wolf and hunt a mammoth without losing a single hunter. But the man who left you to die sits at the same fire every night.
So if you woke up in the Stone Age tomorrow, what would you teach first? Tell me in the comments 👇

entry.title: What If You Could Choose Your Parents?

media:group.media:title: What If You Could Choose Your Parents?
media:group.media:description:
▶ NEW VIDEO: What If You Were Reborn in the Stone Age, but Remembered Everything? https://youtu.be/ZysdNYR3kJE
You're fifteen, your sneakers are held together with duct tape, and your parents can't afford GTA 6. So on your birthday you make a wish: new parents. And it comes true. 🎂
Rich ones who are never home. A mom who never lets you out of her sight. Parents who don't care where you are at night. Parents so strict that nothing is ever good enough. You live every life until you're thirty, and each one turns you into a different person.
So which parents would you pick? Tell me in the comments 👇

You're the slowest swimmer in the club. Kira, your crush, is the best at everything, and she never lets you forget it. One dumb bet keeps you both in the old diving pool after closing… and then the only ladder breaks. 🏊

entry.title: What If Your Dad Was Mike Tyson?

media:group.media:title: What If Your Dad Was Mike Tyson?
media:group.media:description:
▶ NEW VIDEO: What If Robbers Took Over Your Plane and You Had Infinite IQ? https://youtu.be/ijpMgVfhyFc
Imagine you're eleven, pinned against a locker by the biggest kid in school. Then the hallway goes quiet. Your dad just walked in. And your dad is Mike Tyson. 🥊
Twelve rounds of growing up as his son, and every round is scored: the perks or the price. A limo to fight night, a front-row seat, a tiger named Biscuit and a roof full of pigeons… and 4 a.m. runs, a chicken breast for a birthday cake, no right to quit. Then a nine-foot green giant challenges your father to one last fight.
Would you want Mike Tyson as your dad? Tell us in the comments 👇

entry.title: What If You and Your Crush Got Stuck in an Ice Cave?

media:group.media:title: What If You and Your Crush Got Stuck in an Ice Cave?
media:group.media:description:
▶ NEW VIDEO: What If Your Dad Was Mike Tyson? https://youtu.be/NyECEbdzT7Y
You're on Mount Everest at sunrise, roped to your crush. Then you hear a sound like a train. 🏔️
The ground opens and the mountain swallows you both: an ice cave deep inside the glacier. No sky. No signal. Minus fifteen degrees. The radio is dead, the search is called off, the meltwater takes a bag, and now there's only one sleeping bag. Seven days under the ice: a frozen squirrel with an acorn, goodbye videos for home, the truth you never told her… and one ice axe.
Would you dig, or wait for rescue? Tell us in the comments 👇
